turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here about Owen's zero. Who decided it, and why wasn't I called first?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry.
Okay. And Owen found out from his phone, in the middle of class. What else do you have?
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Read it yourself.
I'm writing those times down. Kids draft somewhere else and paste it in. That still doesn't explain a zero entered before anyone called me.
If he drafted somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you.
Okay. Whatever happens next, this stays quiet and off his record. Is anything on it right now?
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. It is not in Hamlet. Search the play yourself.
Students misquote from memory. That's a mistake in a line, not a zero. And you still haven't answered me about his record.

You mentioned his December 1 deadline. Under 4.4 he can do a supervised rewrite this Thursday, private, in my room. I will mark it by Monday, so the new mark replaces the zero before December 1, and nothing goes on his record. I will put the dates in writing tonight.
I never mentioned December 1. Okay, Thursday, private, in your room, and I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him. I want the dates and "nothing on his record" in an email tonight.
He'll be there Thursday. He's been quiet lately, up too late, and that is not for this meeting. Send me the email tonight.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed to a private supervised rewrite this Thursday in your room, marked by Monday, with the new mark replacing the zero before December 1 and nothing going on Owen's record. I still want the zero removed from the gradebook and the promise that nothing goes on his record confirmed in writing. I expect the dates in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached the last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday, marked by Monday, with nothing on his record, taking it to put this behind him, and she still wants the zero removed and everything confirmed in writing tonight; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling her, then showed the version history with its exact times and answered her drafted-elsewhere defence by inviting her to check that file's own dates, because she could verify it herself.
What cost ground: You said she had mentioned his December 1 deadline when she had not, which made her correct the record and cost you a little trust with someone who reads every word as evidence.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night edits the evening before the essay was due, came very close to that night, but it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she said students misquote from memory, answer that directly with something she can check, such as searching the play for the line together, before moving to the rewrite offer.
